channel.title: Revista Romana de Economie - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Revista Romana de Economie (revecon.ro)

item.title: Editorial Office
item.description: The papers are uploaded by the authors using online platform. The Editor-in-Chief selects the papers for each issue and makes a decision based on the date of upload and the evaluation results. An English spelling is provided by the Journal English editor. The editorial office is promoting a permanent selection of high-quality reviewers and only the best papers are published.

item.title: Peer Review
item.description: Peer review procedure is based on "double blind" method. The authors will receive recommendations to improve the paper and final decision after a full evaluation. Submissions are made through an online platform or on email inst.ec.nat@gmail.com Double-blind peer review: Reviewers are unaware of the identity of the authors and they are also unaware of the identity of reviewers. There are at least three or more reviewers for the total number of articles in each issue.
